title: Thermodynamic landscapes of conformational regulation during intrinsically disordered protein fibrillation.
one_liner_zh: 该文结合HyRes粗粒化模型与伞形采样，重建α-突触核蛋白等IDP纤维化各阶段自由能景观，揭示序列静电与构象调控机制，属于蛋白质构象采样的物理模拟核心研究。
abstract: Amyloid fibrillation of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) involves a disorder-to-order transition driven by complex sequence-dependent interactions. However, how amino acid sequences and conformational ordering reshape the multi-chain free-energy landscape during fibril formation remains poorly understood. Here, we combine the hybrid-resolution coarse-grained HyRes model with umbrella sampling to reconstruct the potentials of mean force governing successive stages of IDP fibrillation, including free-chain association, fibril-surface recruitment, and multilayer fibril growth. Using alpha-synuclein, transactive response DNA-binding protein of 43 kDa (TDP-43), and a fibrillar-core construct of fused in sarcoma (FUS-FC) as representative amyloid-forming IDPs, we demonstrate that sequence-encoded electrostatic interactions are a major determinant of association free energies. alpha-Synuclein exhibits the strongest attraction and salt sensitivity, whereas TDP-43 shows weaker electrostatically regulated interactions. Association of the isolated FUS fibrillar core remains thermodynamically unfavorable, whereas inclusion of nonfibrillar regions makes association favorable. Charge-neutralization simulations further reveal the critical role of electrostatics and charge patterning in controlling association. Conformational restraints and fibrillar surface organization further modulate the free-energy landscape in a protein-specific manner, with recruitment governed by the accessibility and arrangement of surface interaction sites rather than fibril thickness alone. These results provide a thermodynamic framework connecting sequence, conformation, and surface organization to the molecular mechanisms of amyloid assembly.
abstract_zh: intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 的淀粉样纤维化涉及由复杂序列依赖性相互作用驱动的无序到有序转变。然而，氨基酸序列和构象有序性如何在纤维形成过程中重塑多链自由能景观，仍知之甚少。在此，我们将混合分辨率粗粒化 HyRes 模型与伞形采样相结合，重建了控制 IDP 纤维化各个阶段（包括自由链结合、纤维表面募集和多层纤维生长）的平均力势。以 α-突触核蛋白 (alpha-synuclein)、43 kDa 反式激活反应 DNA 结合蛋白 (TDP-43) 以及肉瘤融合蛋白纤维核心构建体 (FUS-FC) 作为代表性淀粉样形成 IDP，我们证明序列编码的静电相互作用是结合自由能的主要决定因素。α-突触核蛋白表现出最强的吸引力和盐敏感性，而 TDP-43 则显示出较弱的静电调控相互作用。分离的 FUS 纤维核心的结合在热力学上不利，而包含非纤维区域则使结合变得有利。电荷中和模拟进一步揭示了静电作用和电荷模式在控制结合中的关键作用。构象约束和纤维表面组织进一步以蛋白质特异性的方式调节自由能景观，其中募集由表面相互作用位点的可及性和排列决定，而非仅由纤维厚度决定。这些结果提供了一个热力学框架，将序列、构象和表面组织与淀粉样组装的分子机制联系起来。
